IAF Chief Denies US Offer for F-35 Jets, Cites Access Issues

Air Chief Marshal AP Singh stated that "they don't let us near" F-35 jets, in response to questions about a formal offer from the US for the aircraft. He made these remarks alongside General Kevin Schneider during a press conference, implicitly denying that the US had formally offered the F-35 jets to India.
